task.title: Configure Firefox AI and smart-feature policies
task.shortdesc: Use Step 7 to configure available Firefox policies for AI, visual search, and other smart features.

prereq.p: Select Release 153 or ESR 153.0. Some controls are unavailable on ESR 140.13.

context.p: This topic documents existing Firefox policy settings as product functionality. These browser controls are separate from the documentation assistant and do not change its chat or deterministic search behavior.

info.p: Expected result: the profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Review the browser AI, visual-search, and smart-browser policies supported by the selected schema.

info.p: Expected result: the profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Enable, disable, or leave each supported policy according to the profile goal.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: If a control is absent on ESR 140.13, treat it as unsupported rather than manually inventing a Guided setting.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: Supported Firefox AI and smart-feature policies are reviewed as product settings. They do not control the documentation assistant.

postreq.p: Recovery: if a stakeholder expected an absent ESR control, switch to a supported Release schema for review or document the unsupported state.
